summary: Tested the Meal Plan template, MPA aisle sorting and the Magic Marine Doctor, plus Engine Service engineer regression (mobile 390x844, Pro/Free/Admin). Backend: new test_doctor_aisles_templates.py 15/15 plus test_engineer_ask_signoff.py 18/18 pass, run serially. (1) doctor-ask: the Pro answer ends with the exact safety line and returns asks_left. It adds a 'doctor' ai_draft without touching the engine/mpa/draft counts. 20 fake doctor docs give 429 'Magic Marine Doctor answer'. Free gets 403. Empty, blank or 1025-char questions get 422. (2) mpa/aisles: the Pro mapping uses only the given aisles (Pesto->Herbs, Sweetcorn->Tins & jars, Firelighters->Household). Free gets 403. Empty or blank items/aisles get 422. (3) Admin template-lists keeps 'Salt' under two headings and drops the in-group repeat and the repeated '1. Curry' heading; ids are unique; PUT adds a third Salt. PUT /admin/templates/mealPlan returns 200 and shows in GET /templates. The name 'meal plan' is reserved (400). Frontend: 'Meal Plan' is in the Pro and Free list-selector with 21 numbered meals and 135 items synced to DB. It sits before Head because the seeded Provisions entry was at the end of the registry, which is correct insert logic. mpa-open-btn shows. The MPA dialog lists 'Meal Plan 21 meals MP', '2 adults, 2 children', '3 days', and Sort by shopping aisle is ticked by default. Aisle-sorted output: Meals (21) first, then Fresh produce, Bakery, Meat & fish, Dairy & eggs, Pantry & dry goods, Tins & jars, Herbs spices & sauces, Drinks. It includes Eggs – 18 (Dairy), Beef mince – 750 g (Meat), Water – 36 L and Beer – 18 cans (Drinks). Only the 2 unknown items (Sweetcorn, Pesto) were sent to /ai/mpa/aisles. Unticked gives Meals (21), 'Ingredients for 2 adults and 2 children' and 'Provisions for 3 days', with no aisles call; the same MPA list is updated. Doctor: the panel and label are correct, placeholder ok, maxlength 1024. Textarea is 44px with rows=1 when empty and 84px with rows=3 after typing. Empty Ask shows doctor-error. Then doctor-loading, then an answer card ending with the safety line and '17 questions left today'. The request sent the kit items and 2 adults / 2 children. Close hides the card. No horizontal overflow at 390. Renaming to 'First Aid Kit - advanced for long passage' shows the panel, 'TEST_FAK renamed' hides it, 'first aid kit spare' shows it (case-insensitive). The panel is absent on Meal Plan, Engine Service and Head. On Free, Ask opens the 'Magic Marine Doctor is a Pro feature' dialog with no API call, and the free MPA button opens the upgrade dialog. Engineer regression: label 'ASK THE MAGIC MARINE ENGINEER', placeholder unchanged, engine-type warning with Add engine type / Ask anyway.

ui_bugs.issue: Misclassified built-in items from the Meal Plan. 'Frozen peas' goes to Fresh produce because the 'peas' match runs before Frozen in MATCH order. 'Green beans' goes to Pantry & dry goods (generic 'beans?' match). 'Chilli powder' goes to Fresh produce ('chilli' match; only 'chilli flake' is in the spices regex). Fix: put Frozen first (or check /frozen/ first), add 'green bean' to Fresh produce before Pantry, and add 'powder|chilli powder' to the Herbs/spices regex.

action_items: Fix aisle matching order in aisles.js: Frozen peas -> Frozen, Green beans -> Fresh produce, Chilli powder -> Herbs, spices & sauces
critical_code_review_comments: parse_doctor only checks whether the first 40 chars of the footer appear anywhere in the answer. If the model puts the safety line mid-answer, or pads it, the answer may not END with the exact line. Consider stripping any footer-like line and always appending DOCTOR_FOOTER.

mpa_aisles reuses parse_provisions with the aisle in the 'amount' key. If the AI returns no rows or only invalid aisles, parse_provisions raises 'no amounts' and gives 503; the frontend falls back to Other with a toast. This is acceptable, but a dedicated parser would be clearer.

Meal Plan is added client-side by migrateState and reaches the DB only on the next synced edit. The Free boat DB still lacks mealPlan after a load with no edits. It shows in the UI, so this is fine, but any server-side features reading the registry won't see it until a sync.

Repeated top-level heading in _items_from_labels: dropping '1. Curry' the second time merges its following sub-items into the previous group (e.g. Pepper went under '2. Pasta'). This is the same known behaviour as iteration 44.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_engineer_ask_signoff.py (count() 'other' bucket now excludes doctor too: $nin [engine, doctor], since doctor has its own quota)

These were removed afterwards and the boat restored to pob 3 / 0 / 0. MPA Shopping List and the 'first aid kit spare' list (custom_1793224683809, custom_1793224738456) were removed and added to deleted_lists. Free boat: custom_fak_test was removed and added to deleted_lists. A TEST_Meals Dedupe template list was deleted, and the mealPlan admin template slot was restored (it was absent before). The built-in Meal Plan was kept. Real Gemini calls used: about 2 doctor, 2 aisles, 3 provisions, plus the engineer suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-n 0' (pytest.ini enables xdist). Parallel runs break the ai_drafts quota-count assertions. Seed scripts live in /tmp (seed_boat.py seed|clean, seed_free.py seed|clean); they directly update user_boats registry/data/boat with bumped sec_ts/list_ts. Free users cannot create lists, so seed a 'First Aid Kit...' list in the DB for free-tier Doctor tests.
